text:
ravi-sales: Quick POC ask from Mercury Bank. They want streaming + structured tool calls + schema validation. Unique constraints: Clojure edge adapter (runs on-prem), Elixir orchestration, and they prefer MQTT as a fallback because their telco links favor MQTT over HTTP. Also need SAML SSO, on-prem KMS/HSM glue, and a tight pricing ballpark for 180 qps steady, spikes to 700. Can eng/presales sketch blockers and a short runbook? :wave:

dina-eng: Interesting stack. We don't have a Clojure SDK maintained, but the HTTP streaming patterns are trivial to implement with any HTTP client. For MQTT fallback we can expose a lightweight MQTT bridge that accepts publish/subscribe to a topic-per-session and forwards frames. Will document a minimal protocol for tool_call.parts over MQTT.

ravi-sales: Great. They want ephemeral creds that rotate and can be minted by an internal token service. Any examples?

dina-eng: Ephemeral header approach works: Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>. Rotate ~5m. For MQTT we use username=agent-id, password=ephemeral-token and TLS. We'll add sample snippets for Clojure (clj-http + javax-mqtt) and Elixir (Mint/GenStage).

pablo-ml: Streaming notes: WS default, MQTT fallback ok for intermittent lossy links; SSE not ideal for their pipe. For tool-calls stream parts like: {"type":"tool.part","id":"m-42","payload":{"name":"acct_chk","partial":"{\"id\":\"...\"}"}}. For structured outputs insist on schema_version and a results array so our eval harness can validate. I'll prepare a tiny schema that asserts tool_call shapes.

security-bot: Reminder: provide SOC2 summary, SAML steps, and HSM connector docs. If they require offline KMS, we'll need their HSM integration plan. Also note: Dedicated recommended if sustained >400 qps. GPU lead time ~3-4 weeks.

ravi-sales: Blockers checklist for customer email?

dina-eng: 1) Network path (allowlist IPs OR site-to-site VPN or MQTT bridge outbound). 2) SAML metadata exchange and test IdP. 3) HSM/KMS access plan or test keys. 4) acceptance prompt set + schema contract. 5) model family chosen for cost estimate.

pablo-ml: I'll drop the schema + small eval set that fails on malformed tool-calls.

dina-eng: I'll write the Clojure and Elixir snippets and MQTT bridge proto by EOD tomorrow. Also include ephemeral token examples and minimal runbook for edge adapter.

security-bot: DMing security lead and attaching SOC2 + pen-test summary now.

ravi-sales: Thanks team. I'll build the one-pager and ask Mercury infra for SAML metadata and their MQTT broker details. Target POC start in ~2 weeks pending SAML and network. :calendar: :thumbsup:

[thread end]
